class.name: HSMTransition
class.brief_description: One transition row of a [HierarchicalStateMachine] resource.
class.description: Describes one edge between two sibling states, stored in the [code]transitions[/code] of the machine state that owns them. A row is one of: - [member event] set, [member condition] null: a classic event transition. - [member event] set, [member condition] set: an event transition whose condition is an extra guard. - [member event] empty: a [b]polled[/b] transition, asked on every update while [member from] is active. A null [member condition] always passes, which makes the row a fallback. Polled rows are evaluated by [member priority] (higher first), then rows of the state before ANYSTATE rows, then file order. See [LimboHSM] for the full update order.

method.name: is_polled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member event] is empty, i.e. the row is evaluated on every update rather than on an event.

members.member: The condition that decides whether the row is taken. For a polled row, [code]null[/code] means always. For an event row, it is an extra guard. Each [LimboHSM] built from the resource uses its own copy.
The event that triggers the transition. Empty for a polled row.
The state being left. [code]null[/code] means ANYSTATE: the row applies whichever state is active.
A free text note for the editor. Has no effect at runtime.
Evaluation order of polled rows, higher first. Also passed to [method LimboState._can_exit] of the state being left, for event rows too.
